precepts.text: Rachel demanded children and Jacob asked, Am I in God's stead? The same answer to sisters demanding a lord from leadership: go ask God for it, and ask what he wants you to change first.
precepts.point: This kind can come forth by nothing but by prayer and fasting. Some demons are higher than others, and that is why you have to fast and pray and not let it conquer you. God put leadership in your life to watch over your soul; instead of pointing at them, fix yourself, be the Proverbs 31 woman, stop eating the ice cream at night, and earn it rather than assume you deserve it.
precepts.why:
When Rachel wanted a child and came demanding one from Jacob, “Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?” Jacob could not give what only God gives. Go ask God for that baby.

That is the same answer for the single sister who points at leadership because she has been here five, six, seven years and has no lord, while a sister who came after her already has one. Leadership is not in God’s stead. If you want a lord, go ask God, and ask him what he wants you to change first. Check yourself: maybe talk to the sister who came after you and ask how she did it, instead of calling it hatred from leadership. God put leadership in your life to watch over your soul. Be the Proverbs 31 woman, fix your mouth, do the work on the body, stop eating the ice cream at night, and know your size before you point at the fit brother. It is not something you deserve; it is something you earn, by sacrifice.

The same dumb spirit Christ cast out of the boy tells that sister to go into the world, get a lord, and bring him in, when in the world she caught nothing before. Go into the world and you are still the same negro, still the same woman; you never changed, because you would not go to the Lord. Some came here for the ride and not the work. One sister reached out to a man in the world, and he is gone; another left for a man online who said he did not believe in two or three wives, then found out he did. Some of you are not going to get a lord in this captivity, and if that is what you came for, Satan will move you out of the way.

That spirit is the one that “ofttimes” cast the child “into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him”: the paycheck spent in the club that gets sprayed up, the drunk drive that costs your limbs, the mob on Eastern Parkway, in the mix of a bunch of no-good negroes up to no good. Leaving your house to go with the dumb negroes is a dumb spirit. We thought it was cool; it was a dumb and deaf spirit, not listening and not seeing our condition. “If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth”: your belief is your power. When Satan keeps attacking you, your faith is weak, so cry like the father, “Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.”

“This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.” Some demons are higher than others, so fast and pray, and do not let it conquer you. And once made whole, hear Christ: “sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.” The world you left two years ago is not the world you would go back to; sin has multiplied, and worse demons are jumping on people.

“Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.” How do you cleanse yourself from the foul spirit within you, within us? How does a young woman cleanse her ways from the foul spirit within her? It goes right back to the word of God: you cleanse yourself through the word of God.

So be proactive. If you found your mama’s or daddy’s porn stash back in the day and you know that plagues your mind, put those settings on your phone so you can’t go there, and safeguard your spirit. It’s your salvation that’s on the line.

What does it mean by your hand, your eye, your foot? “If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods”, “Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.”

Your hand, your eye, is your brother, the son of your mother, your son or your daughter, your wife that is in your bosom, or your friend which is as thine own soul, because they are important to you in your life. When one of them entices you away from God, the law says do not consent and do not spare. That is what Christ means by if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: cut off the one close to you who keeps you in sin.

“Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves.” What is the salt? The commandments of God, that preserve you and keep you alive. If you have salt in you, you are preserved. “And have peace one with another”: be at peace with one another.

points: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

So if you want to be great, if you want to be first, you have got to be a servant of all. You have got to be last. And to be last, you have got to become a servant. Christ is not looking for brothers to come up in here puffing up their chest and walking around like they are something. You have got to be a servant. You have got to serve. If you want to be first, you have got to help the people. That is what real leaders do. The job is to help the people, not to put yourself up.

Dumb is spending your money in the club and leaving your house to run with no-good negroes; deaf is not listening and not seeing your condition. When it left, the boy looked dead, then Christ lifted him up and he arose, and now we wake up and see it was a dumb spirit.

points: What are some of the solutions to getting those unclean spirits out, since we come in as broken men and broken women? “This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.” Some spirits that y’all battle with can only come out through prayer and fasting.

Like the weed spirit, weed smoking. Some heard the gospel and put it away as soon as they heard it; for some of you it’s not that easy. Some of you been in the truth for a couple of years and you’re still battling with weed: it’s time to pray, it’s time to fast. And some of you got that sex demon on you.

note.label: Buck Breaking and Building God's People

points: “This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.” Some brothers are so depressed and so down on themselves that nothing but prayer and fasting will do. Some do not fast enough: they do not take the opportunity of the monthly fast, the bi-weekly fast, the Day of Atonement. These depressed, evil spirits cannot leave you except through prayer and fasting.

“I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit”: a dumb spirit, meaning unable to speak. The father gives the attributes of what his son deals with: “he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away”. He foams at the mouth, he grinds his teeth, he pines away, like a person scratching at a tree or a wall.

Today you would call that schizophrenia, but the father called it a dumb spirit. There are different spectrums of schizophrenia. Schizophreniform disorder is having the symptoms of schizophrenia for a period of one to six months: delusions, hallucinations, disorganized speech, odd behaviors, lack of energy and social withdrawal. A lot of times we say, I’m an introvert, which is a social disorder. It is part of the schizophrenia spectrum and can be an early sign of it. It affects men and women equally, but it usually develops at a younger age in men, and it can happen very quickly. And here a man came to Christ about his son.

“Straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.” As the young brother is on the ground foaming at the mouth, Christ asks the father, “How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.” This is very important. Schizophreniform starts in men at a younger age.

The spirits we’ve been going over, the hatred, the evil concupiscence, the sexual sins, the lying, some of those spirits have been on you since you were a child. A lot of the evil concupiscence you lust after now is because you found your daddy’s or your mama’s porn stash when you were a little kid. You were exposed at a very young age, and now you grow up knowing things a child should not know. There’s a spirit in pornography, there’s a spirit in the dysfunctional houses many of us came up in, and often it begins to afflict you while you’re a child.

DMX told how someone he looked up to laced a blunt with crack when he was fourteen, and asked why would you do that to a child. Then when he bugs out as an adult we laugh and say he’s got to stop smoking that crack. The demons we wrestle with came upon us while we were still children. Many of you were ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen years old when you found that porn stash and have not been able to put it away since, because a demonic door was opened to you from that point on.
“And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him”. The spirit that’s in many of us desires to destroy you.

A brother has a lust in him and a sister has a lust in her: how do they find each other? He looked across the room and lined up and saw her? It has nothing to do with your flesh. The demon in you is saying woohoo to the demon in her on the other side of the room, and her demon is saying woohoo back, and they agree together to be in the midst of fornication. It’s a spiritual thing: the demon in you found a demon in her.
“If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.” If you believe, all things are possible.

“Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.” The father cried out with tears: Lord, you see something in me that I’m lacking, help me. This is why Christ was daily in the temple teaching all those things that benefit us, and one of the things that benefits us is knowing we need help from the Lord.

“He rebuked the foul spirit”. Earlier in the chapter it was called a dumb spirit. The father didn’t know the fullness of what Christ knew: the father only spoke on what he could see, a dumb spirit trying to destroy his son, but Christ said it’s a foul, filthy spirit in that young boy. Hatred is a foul spirit. Evil concupiscence that goes into sodomy is a foul spirit. Envy, porn, bestiality, whatever you want to name it, those are foul spirits. Until you start deeming the spirits within us as foul, you will never get rid of them. Don’t make light of it like the father did. Many of us have to have that same reckoning: it’s a foul, filthy spirit within us.

“Come out of him, and enter no more into him.” You may think you’ve gotten rid of a spirit, but Satan definitely makes a comeback. Look where lustful, evil concupiscence can lead: a man of thirty-eight who killed his sixteen-year-old niece after impregnating her, a man of forty-one who killed his girlfriend’s thirteen-year-old niece after impregnating her. While he was with the so-called girlfriend, who was he really paying attention to? Then to cover up his foul spirit he murdered the young sister. Many of you say, I would never go that far, and Satan says hold my cup. You don’t know yourself, because even the beginning stages of this spirit are foul.

And all you old ass men with beards and back hair, a whole job with a pension package, pulling up to the high school picking up little girls with flowers and balloons: foul spirits. All praises for repentance, but what the scripture is saying is ask the Lord that the spirit don’t come back upon you, because Satan ain’t done until we’re in the ground or Christ comes.

“And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead”. Paul says I die daily, and when you get rid of those spirits it’s like you’re dying behind it. You think those spirits are going to say, I’m packing my bags, see you later? No. That spirit hangs on to you like somebody dragged out by their feet. It doesn’t want to leave its house. It has been comfortable there since you were a child, warm, fed, everything it needs, and you’re giving it an eviction notice out of the blue because you read it out of a book. That spirit is kicking and screaming. This is war.

“Insomuch that many said, He is dead.” Dying daily ain’t just about you. Everybody has to be able to recognize, wait a minute, that brother was robbing people, being a thief, and he ain’t that guy no more. They have to see that the spirit has died in you. Your death is not a one-person vigil. You are a walking billboard for Christ. None of these things should be named among any of us: put it away, cast it out. You have the power to do it; many times we just don’t use the power the Lord gave us.

“But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.” The disciples asked privately, “Why could not we cast him out?” And Christ said, “This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.” Christ is saying you are able to do the exact same thing.

Many of us say, I’ve been fasting a long time about this and I still battle with it. Maybe it’s not just how often you fast but the duration of your fast. A lot of brothers have already changed to one meal a day, so fasting for one day is pretty much what you’re already doing. Change the duration: go three days, four days, five days. If you really want that spirit to leave you, there is no extent you won’t go. The white man is a damn liar saying you’re going to die if you don’t drink water for three days. All things can be done through the Lord. Don’t get faint-hearted.
“And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone”, a huge rock, “were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.”

“And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off.” It doesn’t mean literally cut off your hand. The hand that offends you is somebody close to you: your wife, your husband, your son, your daughter, a friend, your mother or father.

“It is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell”: better to lose that hand, lose your friend, lose your spouse, lose your child, than to go into hell. And he explains the hell: “into the fire that never shall be quenched.” No camp has explained that. They say there is no hell, no destruction, no eternal condemnation. Then what is that? That is the condemnation Christ was talking about, and the condemnation Daniel was talking about.

An example of offence: an Israelite camp teaching that it is okay to go out and buy prostitutes, because many of our forefathers dealt with them. That is an offence, and the Bible says cut that person off. Bro, you got to go; you and me can’t hang out no more, because you are trying to keep me in that lifestyle.
“Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.” That worm is your soul: where their soul dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

“And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off.” Your foot is still your spouse, your mother, your father, your son or daughter, or your friend which is as your own soul. “It is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched.”

He is reiterating it, in case you don’t understand how important this is: you have friends, associates, family members who are keeping you in sin. Cut them off, because if you don’t, you will enter into that fire that never shall be quenched.

Another example: camps saying you can punch a black woman in the face and rape her, even twelve years old, and still go to the kingdom. That is not what we teach. Those are men with Bibles, but you can’t find that in the Bible; the only conclusion is that the government is indoctrinating these men to teach that, so you don’t believe you are who the Bible says you are. Where is the self-control, the self-discipline? That is what Christ tried to bring into our minds. And never let it be said that we slander anyone: we let their own words speak for themselves.

“And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out”: your eye once again is a spouse, mother or father, son, daughter, or your friend which is as your own soul. “It is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire: Where their worm dieth not”, where your soul doesn’t die, “and the fire is not quenched.” It is unquenchable fire.

People say we slander them. It is correction. The correction some camps give is based on hatred: a leader putting curses on the Bishop and his followers and on all the Israelites who are not with him, and telling his brothers to keep putting curses on them that the Most High may destroy them. Is that love or hate? That is hate, and the camps that follow such men will get the same judgment.
